This is an unstructured, long-form text column that includes explanations, clarifications, detailed insights, context and critical evaluation of the variables reported in the final DF9 Metadata Report (Cowgill et al., 2012). Not all variables are covered in equal amounts.

This is an unstructured, long-form text column that conjoins with (is a continuation of) "DF9Metadata_VarText". The text of the DF9 Metadata Report (Cowgill et al., 2012) discusses variables in hierarchical groups, with subheadings for individual variables. As such, the long-form text for the variable group being discussed is included here in "DF9Metadata_VarGroupText" --  and thus should be read and analyzed alongside the information for specific variables included in "DF9Metadata_VarTex". Frequently, the text in "DF9Metadata_VarGroupText" directly pertains to individual variables in addition to the group as a whole. In some cases most of the info is in "DF9Metadata_VarGroupText", while in others most of the info is in "DF9Metadata_VarGroupText". As such, "DF9Metadata_VarGroupText" and "DF9Metadata_VarText" should always be consulted together.
